Create test items

Create a small item family, purchased components and one manufactured item, ready for a production order.

Walked in LN, Aug 2026
Common
Procurement
Manufacturing
Warehousing

Start11 tasks · 116 steps

The tasks, in order

  1. 1Confirm the test designSite, warehouses, units, and unused item codes are known. · 10 steps
  2. 2Create two item groupsPurchase and Job Shop defaults remain isolated from each other. · 6 steps
  3. 3Configure the purchased groupBAM-RM can create Ordering, Purchase, and Warehousing data. · 14 steps
  4. 4Configure the made groupBAM-FG can create Ordering, Production, Warehousing, and Sales data. · 10 steps
  5. 5Verify site creation controlSite-level creation agrees with the company defaults. · 4 steps
  6. 6Create the three itemsEach item inherits its group's defaults and its site row shows the intended role. · 11 steps
  7. 7Build the job shop bill of materialThe pair has an Approved BOM carrying both components. · 19 steps
  8. 8Build the job shop routingThe pair has an Approved routing with an operation at a work center. · 19 steps
  9. 9Confirm costing dataEvery item in the family carries the standard cost the estimate calculation reads. · 6 steps
  10. 10Stock the componentsThe rod and sleeve are on hand at the raw-material warehouse. · 10 steps
  11. 11Qualify the training caseThe family satisfies Confirm the test design of the production-order walkthrough. · 7 steps
    • A package indicator is active but the item subentity is not created

      Verify the separate Create Item control at the governing global or site level

    • Minimum two-item test

      Create only one purchased material and one Job Shop finished product. This proves the two supply patterns but gives the later BOM only one material class

    • Recommended three-item test

      Use this full walkthrough: two purchased inputs and one Job Shop finished product

    • Four-item multilevel test

      Add a semi-finished level only after the single-level case works; it requires another made-item master, BOM, routing, and costing layer, and a second production order

    • Purchased finished goods

      Use another dedicated Product group with Default Supply Source = Purchase; no Job Shop Production defaults are required, and phases 6–7 do not apply

    • The bamboo family is qualified — items, site rows, an approved BOM and routing, costing, and component stock on hand

      Production order
